verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own Filters & Rules (Sieve filters into folders) let a power-user route mail into separate streams, and users describe it as 'excellent for explicit organisation.' However, it has no automatic categorization into priority streams: users repeatedly say they miss Gmail's primary/promotions/social/updates tabs, have built 'a convoluted mess of filters,' and note that filters don't apply to existing mail. missing for 10: built-in automatic stream/category separation (important, newsletters, calendar invites), documented split-inbox or priority triage view, filter behavior on existing mail, in-depth first-party docs beyond the Filters & Rules article title.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order

citations.quote: Fastmail is excellent for explicit organisation
